messages.subject: Bug?
parts:
Hi,

I´m doing the following extracted from an R book:

      everyday = seq(from= as.Date('2005-1-1'), to= as.Date('2005-12-31'), by= 'day')
      cut(everyday, breaks= 'week')

and the result is a:

Java::JavaLang::ClassCastException: org.renjin.sexp.DoubleArrayVector cannot be cast to org.renjin.sexp.IntVector
    org.renjin.primitives.time.PosixLtVector.<init>(org/renjin/primitives/time/PosixLtVector.java:39)
    org.renjin.primitives.time.Time.POSIXlt2Date(org/renjin/primitives/time/Time.java:145)

Thanks,


Rodrigo
